name: work_permits
description: Schema for agricultural work permits data extracted from Danish Landbrugsvisum PDFs

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year of the work permit (dynamically extracted from PDF)

columns.name: nationality
columns.description: Nationality/country of origin for the work permit holders

columns.name: first_permits_count
columns.description: Number of first-time work permits issued

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Name of the source PDF file

columns.name: extracted_at
columns.description: Timestamp when data was extracted from the PDF

metadata.description: Countries and years are dynamically extracted from PDF content rather than hardcoded
metadata.note: This allows the scraper to handle new countries and years automatically as they appear in the data
